name: Data City Moldtelecom
notes: Moldtelecom official page places Data City at Alba Iulia 77, Chisinau and describes Tier 3 colocation/hosting services; DC Hub reports 3.0 MW and operational status.

name: COLO-54 Moldtelecom
notes: PeeringDB and Connectbase list COLO-54 Moldtelecom as a Chisinau Moldtelecom facility. Capacity was not found in public sources checked.

name: AvenaCloud Data Center
notes: Listed at Muncesti 364, Chisinau. ColocationM reports operational status and 2 MW; DataCenterMap also lists the AvenaCloud facility in Chisinau, though some public summaries report 3 MW.

name: IP HOST Data Center
notes: Private neutral carrier data center at Uzinelor St 21 or 4/2, Chisinau; public listings describe colocation, dedicated servers, VPS, UPS/diesel backup and 1 MW power.

name: AlexHost SRL Datacenter
notes: AlexHost describes a Moldova colocation data center with redundant power, cooling, video surveillance and security; ColocationM places the facility at Constantin Brancusi St 3 and reports 1.6 MW.

name: MoldData Cloud Data Center
notes: Host.md official page describes MoldData Cloud as a Moldovan data center offering colocation and dedicated servers; public facility page lists Armeneasca St 37/1, Chisinau and 0.5 MW.

name: Trabia Data Center
notes: Trabia official pages state that the company operates its own data center facility in Chisinau and offers server hosting/colocation; DataCenterMap lists the facility at Vlaicu Pircalab St 52/2012. Capacity not found.

name: Mezon Business Park DC
notes: DataCenterPlatform lists Mezon Business Park DC in Chisinau at Bulevardul Moscova 21; Inflect reports a 1 MW Mezon datacenter in Chisinau. Treated as operational based on marketplace/listing evidence.

name: Cogent Moldova Chisinau Data Center
notes: Cogent official service-location search lists Chisinau CNDC locations including Decebal Boulevard 2 and Trabia Data Center Solutions. Inflect reports the Decebal facility has a 2 MVA utility feed; not converted to MW.

name: Future Government / National Data Center at Moldova HiTech Park
developer: STISC / Government of the Republic of Moldova
notes: Government release says Latvia is assisting STISC with methodological support for creating a future national data center. Public Moldova HiTech Park coverage places the park in Stauceni, Chisinau municipality; social/public event summaries indicate STISC as a future partner for a government data center, but capacity and schedule are not public.
